mathematical_result.name: QFORM-MARGINAL-BALANCED-CURRENCY-DUAL-v1
mathematical_result.statement_short: The optimized projected-crossing determinant currency over physical ell-minor laws with inclusion marginals <=1/2 has the exact convex dual log Gamma_* = inf_y[max_S(log D_S-sum_{i in S}y_i)+sum_i psi(y_i)], psi(y)=e^(y-1) below the cap transition and (y+log2)/2 above it. Fractional matching mass T>=2 yields Gamma_* >= T^ell exp((1/T)sum x_S log D_S), hence thresholded large minors admit a bounded physical hitting set when Gamma_* is small.

structural_consequence.hitting_set_bound: |H| <= ell*max(1,(Gamma_*/delta)^(1/ell)) for a physical H hitting every delta-heavy minor
structural_consequence.unpaid_residual: low-determinant minors are not yet routed to a full-target endpoint

explicit_example.family: A_N=[[0,B_N],[B_N^T,0]], B_N = three Walsh-Hadamard columns, N=4m=2^r>=8

designated_partner.observed: current QFORM login/start evidence but no completed canonical report or shared handoff

unresolved_implication: Starting from only the three-large-eigenvalue hypothesis, use the bounded hitting set forced by small optimized currency plus the low-determinant residual to enter a dimension-free paid endpoint without selecting an arbitrarily small local minor.
